problem.title: Today's shortcuts are tomorrow's bad grades.

cards.title: ChatGPT gives you the answer
cards.body: You copy, you paste, you pass that day. But in the exam, with no ChatGPT, your mind goes blank.

cards.title: Photomath solves it for you
cards.body: You see the solution but never learn the method. Change the numbers and you're stuck again.

cards.title: Estudia+ makes you think
cards.body: Graduated hints, a Socratic coach, similar exercises. You learn it FOR REAL — and you show it in the exam.

howItWorks.title: From stuck to mastery, in 3 steps

steps.title: Upload your notes or paste the problem
steps.body: PDF, photo or text. Estudia+ processes the material and picks out the key concepts.

steps.title: The Coach guides you with hints, never with answers
steps.body: A three-level Socratic system. If you've genuinely tried, you move fast. If you're after a shortcut, it sends you back to think.

steps.title: You keep what you learn with smart flashcards
steps.body: The scientific FSRS algorithm (the same one Anki uses). You review right before you'd forget. Maximum retention, minimum effort.

whenToUse.title: Honest truth: it's not magic for exam week.
whenToUse.subtitle: Estudia+ builds real knowledge. That takes time. Here's when it makes the biggest difference:

cards.title: During the term
cards.body: You learn new concepts with the Socratic coach, build flashcards from your syllabus, and review them before you forget. This is where Estudia+ shines.

cards.title: Weeks before the exam
cards.body: Review your entire FSRS deck, take practice exams from your syllabus, and identify specific gaps to drill.

cards.title: The night before the exam
cards.body: This isn't our strong suit. In panic mode with no time, grab past papers from your exam board, mark schemes, and drill your weak points. Estudia+ slows you down here — that doesn't help.

features.title: What no other app puts together

items.title: A proven Socratic method
items.body: Studies show 3× better learning than tools that hand over the answer. You learn to think for yourself.

items.title: Built for your exam board
items.body: IGCSE, IB, A-Levels, AP, US High School, LOMLOE. Estudia+ knows the command words, the mark schemes and the house style of each one.

items.title: Flashcards powered by FSRS
items.body: The same scientific algorithm as Anki. It schedules every review at the optimal moment: maximum retention, minimum time.

items.title: Academic integrity, built in
items.body: An anti-cheating filter: no attempt, no help. Designed for learning, not for copying.

items.q: Can I use Estudia+ on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Estudia+ is a PWA (Progressive Web App), so you can install it on iOS and Android just like a native app, and the essentials work offline. No App Store required.

items.q: What languages is it available in?
items.a: The interface is in Spanish and English. Your subject content can be in any language you like, and you can even mix them: “Biología” in Spanish and “History” in English in the same account.

items.q: Is it safe for academic use?
items.a: Yes — it is built precisely to protect your academic integrity. The Homework Coach has an anti-shortcut filter: if you haven't tried to solve the exercise first, you don't get help. And the hints are graduated, never straight solutions. Estudia+ helps you learn, not copy.

items.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
items.a: Yes, in one click from your profile. No phone calls, no emails, no lock-in. And if you are on the yearly plan, we refund the part you haven't used.
